name: OpenVocabDet
narrative: explores a training-free way to improve open-vocabulary detection. Frozen CLIP revisits the proposals produced by Grounding DINO and reranks them against the query, adding a second look without introducing another training stage. On COCO val2017, this small intervention raises AP from 48.61 to 49.64.

name: NJU Rule RAG
narrative: is a retrieval-augmented assistant for Nanjing University regulations and academic procedures. It turns 220 institutional documents into 3,441 searchable chunks, then combines BGE-M3 retrieval, Qwen3 generation, and a FastAPI service into answers that are grounded in the source material. Typical responses arrive in 1.76 seconds.

name: CIFAR-10 CNN
narrative: is an experiment record rather than a single final model. Starting from a basic convolutional baseline, the project traces the decisions that move accuracy from 63% to beyond 90%: stronger augmentation, more deliberate optimization, and a gradual step toward ResNet-style structure. Everything is implemented and compared in PyTorch.

name: OnlineQuiz
narrative: is a small browser workspace for completing Digital System Design coursework. It keeps answers in local storage, keeps the workflow inside the browser, and exports completed responses as a PDF when the work is ready to hand in. The aim is simply to make a repetitive course task feel calmer and more reliable.
